Borrowed from Nepali barsa. Watters marks the headword (Nep.); Aaley & Bodt mark the concept < NEP बर्ष barṣa ‘year’. Turner N. barsa ‘year’; Watters’s bəsə has lost the /r/. Kusunda Nepali-loan review 2026-09-24.
